items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's question 'You remember him, too, sonny?' with any personal anecdote or confirmation of a relationship, only acknowledging the name in the flow of conversation.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was all right. Yeah. Yeah, he's good. Dorito. Yeah, Morris French. This boy, uh... But I was telling you about that, it left you and went away.
Drew. Drew Robertson. Drew Robertson. Yeah. You remember him, too, sonny? I played with him, too, in the Allen Band a couple of times.
Yeah. Was he a... Did he play Barrow House, too, or did he just read? Was he?
